lines.t: Can you hear it?
The sound in the distance…
Shadows of men have covered the altar
Words of the ancient twisted and sold
Yet the fire still burns in the hearts of the remnant
Who refuse the silver and refuse the gold
Lift up your eyes, the sky is splitting
Every false tower will fall to the ground
The voice that spoke worlds into being
Is speaking again
can you hear it?
Behold the Lamb, behold the Lion
Who was, and is, and is to come
The sealed are rising, the chains are breaking
The King of Majesty is on the move
No more delay, no more compromise
They built their temples with hands of flesh
They sang their songs with borrowed light
But the true ones walk in the fear of The Lord
And keep the appointed day and night
The winepress is ready, the harvest is near
The sickle is sharp and the angels take flight
Those who have washed their robes in His blood
Will stand in the day that turns darkness to light
Behold the Lamb, behold the Lion
Who was, and is, and is to come
The sealed are rising, the chains are breaking
The King of glory is on the move
No more delay, no more compromise
it is written, Come out from among them
Touch not the unclean thing
I will be a Father to you
And you will be My sons and daughters
He is the Lamb, He is the Lion
Who was, and is, and is to come
The sealed are rising, the chains are breaking
The King of glory is on the move
No more delay… no more compromise…
No more delay… no more compromise…
